card.title: Let the outreach tool read your Gmail and save drafts?
card.context: The outreach tool writes first emails to clinics for you. To see who replied and to save its emails as drafts in your Gmail (you still press send yourself), it needs your permission on your Google account. It can only read mail and save drafts.
card.question: Should the outreach tool get read and draft access to your Gmail?

choices.label: Yes: create the app in Google Cloud console, paste its client secret here, then press Allow on Google's page
choices.pros: the tool sees replies and saves drafts
choices.cons: the tool can read your whole mailbox

choices.label: Not now
choices.pros: nothing gets access to your mail

card.why: Missed replies cost clinics; the setup takes about ten minutes of your time.
